agents.task: Review PortraitHeadMesh bounds/BVH hit handling and finite geometry tests; focus bounded work, malformed input and culling validity.

outcome.status: No confirmed material defect in assigned mesh scope.
outcome.basis: Geometry and BVH are immutable and privately constructed from fixed finite constants, with no external vertex/node input. Median subdivision strictly reduces ranges to at most eight triangles per leaf. The prescribed topology produces 5248 nondegenerate triangles, so traversal work is bounded even without culling. Node bounds derive from all descendant triangle vertices; positive padding is conservative. Triangles enforce minimum <= distance < maximum; tie handling retains the true smallest distance and never extends the caller maximum.

No production route accepting arbitrary mesh data or unvalidated pixel/shadow rays was identified, so that coverage limitation is not classified as a product defect.
